correctness.rationale: Equation (1) follows by differentiation under cold cutoff with vanishing moving-endpoint integrand; stationarity ratio increases strictly from 1 to infinity; derivative at hot cutoff is negative; equation (2) pointwise decreases beyond cutoff; boundary mean handled explicitly. Monotone F with H' strictly negative gives sharp constants and limiting cases. Packaged checker passed 1835 numerical assertions; no finite testing is used as infinite proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The present claim is not merely the consequence that thermal variation can raise growth or that quadratics may peak. It additionally establishes a global all-amplitude uniqueness boundary and universal fractional location strictly below the upper viable temperature. The inspected primary statements do not logically imply either sharp constant without additional computation and assumptions.

A generic nonlinear-variance optimum does not imply these constants.

value.rationale: The exact cold-mean development benchmark resolves nontrivial competition of threshold rescue and hot dilution: one global optimum and a sharp universal lower/upper location of optimum hottest temperature for every cold offset. It clarifies which temperature excursions help despite a subthreshold mean and supplies rigorous calibration checks for physiological-rate simulation; it is not merely a plotted numerical instance or general Jensen statement.
